The ground everything

URI is the ground I build everything on - faith, and justice as the restoration of right relationship. What you'll actually see and experience are the frameworks that grow out of it: UNMASK and CHOICE.

See Where This Shows Up
In Plain Terms

Three ideas. Nothing to book here.

URI isn't a service and it isn't for sale. It's the test everything else has to pass.

⚓

Faith

Rooted in womanist theology - Black women's experience as a source of wisdom, not just survival.

✊🏾

Justice

Justice is the restoration of right relationship - with people, with structure, with Spirit.

🔍

Structure

Power and systems examined honestly - not corporate management theory in different clothes.

What's Grown From It

Two frameworks so far.

Framework

UNMASK

Born in BIWOC coaching. Names the architecture of structural burnout - language for what's happening, and why it was never a personal failing.

Framework

CHOICE

Names the conditions - mental, emotional, environmental - that shape what a person is actually free to choose, before anyone calls it a choice at all.
